area: US human trafficking indicators & federal hotline referral logic (NHTH / DHS Blue Campaign)
why: DHS Blue Campaign indicator checklists + NHTH triage protocols are PDFs; base models hedge on jurisdiction-specific referral thresholds and mandatory-reporter triggers; gap is structural because ground truth is in hotline SOPs that are periodically revised and never fully digitized in training corpora

area: ILO forced-labor indicators & forced-labour protocol ratification status (P029)
why: ILO P029 ratification list changes when states ratify; the 11 forced-labour indicators in ILO Indicators of Forced Labour (2012) are stable text but base models misidentify which indicator a described scenario maps to; structural because scenario-to-indicator mapping requires the enumerated list and new thematic guidance (e.g. debt bondage in fisheries)

area: FATF Recommendations & mutual evaluation report findings (AML/CFT)
why: FATF publishes Mutual Evaluation Reports (MERs) per jurisdiction detailing gap ratings for each of 40 Recommendations; ratings change on re-evaluation; base models fabricate country-level compliance ratings and confuse Immediate Outcome scores with Technical Compliance; structural because MERs are PDFs updated on rolling jurisdiction schedule

area: UN sanctions list real-time delta monitoring (UNSC Consolidated List)
why: UNSC Consolidated List publishes XML delta files; base models have no live view of listing/delisting events; structural because velocity of delta events (additions/amendments) is ongoing and requires real-time diff logic, not static knowledge

area: US OSHA construction standards & citation data (29 CFR 1926 + OSHA enforcement data)
why: OSHA publishes machine-readable enforcement/inspection data; base models hallucinate specific CFR subpart requirements and cite outdated penalty amounts; structural because penalty schedules update annually (inflation adjustment) and inspection-outcome data is a live feed not in training weights

area: EU Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive (CS3D) supply-chain obligations
why: CS3D entered into force June 2024; transposition deadlines staggered to 2026-2027 by company tier; base models conflate CS3D with CSRD and fabricate scope thresholds; structural because national transposition laws will differ across member states and the EUR-Lex chain from directive to implementing acts is a living tree

area: US FDA food safety FSMA rules — preventive controls & foreign supplier verification (FSVP)
why: FSMA Final Rules (21 CFR 117, 21 CFR 1.500-1.514) include FSVP obligations for importers; base models conflate HACCP (old) and FSMA (new) obligations and fabricate importer-size exemption thresholds; structural because FDA issues draft guidance and enforcement discretion letters that modify real compliance expectations without amending the CFR text

area: WHO prequalification status & EML updates for essential medicines
why: WHO Prequalification List and Essential Medicines List (EML) update on rolling cycle; base models cite outdated prequalification status and incorrect EML edition numbers; structural because prequalification decisions (additions/withdrawals) are published in batches and the ground truth is only authoritative in the current web-published list, not training corpora

area: UNHCR displacement & refugee registration data (real-time population statistics)
why: UNHCR popstats provides machine-readable population figures that update monthly/annually; base models cite year-old figures as current; structural because displacement populations shift dramatically with crises (e.g. Sudan, Gaza 2024-2025) and a static-weight model can never track event-driven deltas

area: FEMA disaster declaration & hazard-mitigation grant data (US Stafford Act grants)
why: FEMA OpenFEMA API exposes disaster declarations, public assistance, and HMGP grants; base models hallucinate current open declarations and confuse Individual Assistance with Public Assistance eligibility rules; structural because declarations open and close with events and funding caps reset per disaster

area: EU REACH substance restriction & SVHC candidate list (ECHA)
why: ECHA updates SVHC Candidate List twice yearly and Annex XVII restriction entries irregularly; base models cite outdated lists and fabricate restriction conditions for specific articles; structural because the authoritative list is ECHA-web-published and regulatory amendments add/modify entries continuously

area: US EPA TRI reporting thresholds & enforcement actions (Toxics Release Inventory)
why: EPA TRI is machine-readable (Envirofacts API); base models hallucinate facility-specific thresholds and confuse Section 313 chemicals with Section 302 EHS chemicals; structural because chemical additions/removals to TRI list require rulemaking and facility-level release data updates annually

area: NIST AI RMF & AI 100-1 conformance mapping (US AI governance)
why: NIST AI RMF 1.0 (Jan 2023) + AI RMF Playbook + AI 100-1 (Adversarial ML) form a living reference ecosystem; EO 14110 revocation by successor order shifts mandatory vs. voluntary status of RMF actions; base models fabricate which RMF functions/categories apply to a given system and confuse GOVERN/MAP/MEASURE/MANAGE sub-actions; structural because NIST issues profiles, sector-specific extensions, and companion documents on a rolling basis

area: ILO child labour hazardous work lists & national minimum age ratifications (C138/C182)
why: ILO C138/C182 ratification status is tracked in NORMLEX; national hazardous-work lists under C182 are country-specific secondary instruments rarely digitized in English; base models fabricate minimum ages for specific sectors and conflate national instruments with ILO convention text; structural because country-specific implementing orders are in national gazettes (low-resource, sparse English)

area: US FinCEN Beneficial Ownership registry (CTA — Corporate Transparency Act)
why: CTA BOI reporting began Jan 2024; FinCEN issued multiple deadline extensions, injunction-driven pauses, and rule amendments in 2024-2025; base models fabricate current filing deadlines and exemption category thresholds; structural because the rule has been in active litigation/amendment and the authoritative compliance state at any point in time is a live legal status the model cannot retrieve
